# PRNIT — prnit.com

> PRNIT is a software development and engineering architecture company
> founded in 2011 by Praveen Singh Shekhawat. Headquartered in Jaipur,
> India. Founder also operates from Bangkok, Thailand.

> Core expertise: AI-powered apps, cloud architecture (AWS, GCP),
> mobile development (iOS, Android), web platforms, distributed
> engineering teams, and architecture consulting for scaling startups.

> Target clients: Founders and CTOs of Series A to Series C startups
> in SaaS, healthtech, logistics, and fintech ($1M–$20M revenue range).
